---
title: "Virome library — Figure 1A (v9, 4 panels)"
author: ""
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

## Overview

Four panels, left to right.

| Panel | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| 1 | `GREY_REFSEQ` = NCBI RefSeq complete genomes not in the library; `GREY_LIB` = ordered library |
| 2 | `GREY_LIB` = accessions with an XR (stall) site (no input backdrop, no phylum colour) |
| 3 | `GREY_LIB` = XR-positive accessions (same bar as panel 2); colour = CM class / CM hit over top. **Main Figure-1 panel.** |
| 4 | 3′UTR (orange) + intergenic (blue) feature length boxplots |

### Changes from v7

1. **Grey scheme.** Two greys, each with one meaning across all panels:
   - `GREY_REFSEQ` (light): in RefSeq, not in the library. Used in panel 1 only.
   - `GREY_LIB` (dark): in the library. Used as the denominator of every panel.

   In v7 the panel-1 "not in library" grey (`grey88`) was the same value as the panel-4 "XR hit,
   no CM hit" backdrop, so two opposite meanings shared one shade. Every panel's grey now marks that
   panel's denominator, which is always a subset of the library, and `grey88` appears nowhere else.
2. **Fiersviridae excluded at every input**, by family name and by accession
   (`EXCLUDE_FAMILIES`, `EXCLUDE_ACCESSIONS`), not only at the taxonomy table. A `stopifnot` halts the
   knit if any excluded family or accession reaches a plotted table.
3. Legend keys added for both greys (panels 1 and 3), so the shades are defined on the figure itself.
4. **Only models known before this study are shown**: xrRNA classes 1a, 1b, 2, 3, 4 and the dumbbell
   element (Rfam RF00525, published). Models developed during the study (class1c, later an expanded
   class 1b and other subclasses) stay in the peaks table but are not drawn, and `any_hit` is recomputed
   over the shown models only, so they do not count toward "with a CM match".

**Sample identity:** R1/R2/R3 = RppH-only (no Xrn1) = input; X1/X2/X3 = Xrn1 = output.

**XR-positive:** tiles pass when `treated_sf ≥ 0.3`, `ctrl_sf ≤ 0.1`, `fold_change ≥ 3`,
`stall_reads ≥ 10`, `qvalue ≤ 0.01` in ≥ `MIN_REPS` replicates. Each accession counted once
(best tile).

**Denominator throughout is the ordered library** — 1,521 features / 1,226 genome accessions
(1,055 viruses), less the 2 excluded Fiersviridae accessions.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)
library(svglite)

# ── Config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Inputs currently in the legacy subdirectory inputs/20261019_rerun_viromelib_ordered/.
# LAYOUT.txt section 3 prefers a FLAT inputs/ with the run in the filename; when you flatten
# (FIGURES.md section 11.6), set INPUT_DIR back to ".../fig1/inputs".
INPUT_DIR  <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/inputs/20261019_rerun_viromelib_ordered"

FASTA_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "pilot_library_20260319.uniqueIDs.ordered.fa")
CSV_FILE      <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "virus_taxonomy_261019.csv")
PRESENCE_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "accession_presence_by_sample_261019.csv")
# Six-CM re-annotation of the viromelib orderedRef run: the models known before this study
# (1a, 1b, 2, cl3, class4_cl4_v9, dumbbell_RF00525). Produced by the re-annotation in
# FIGURES.md section 11, downloaded, run-prefixed. md5 in inputs/MANIFEST.tsv.
# The 2026-10-19 five-CM peaks_annotated.csv (md5 4f452542...) predates this and lacks dumbbell.
PEAKS_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "261019_re-run_viromelib_orderedRef.peaks_annotated_known6cm.csv")
NCBI_FILE     <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "ncbi_family_counts_261019.csv")

# Excluded from the figure (run log, decision 23):
#   Fiersviridae -- NC_055057.1 and NC_074553.1 ("Leviviridae sp.", TaxID 2027243) are
#   bacteriophages from rhesus macaque faecal metagenomes. They passed the eukaryotic-host design
#   query because NCBI records the host of the sample, not of the phage. Neither has a passing
#   site. The family holds thousands of phage species, so its RefSeq bar would dominate a
#   eukaryotic-host family axis while representing two accidental accessions.
#   Excluded by family AND by accession, so a family-label difference between input tables
#   cannot let them back in. Set both to character(0) to show them.
EXCLUDE_FAMILIES   <- c("Fiersviridae", "Leviviridae")
EXCLUDE_ACCESSIONS <- c("NC_055057.1", "NC_074553.1")
EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN  <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", EXCLUDE_ACCESSIONS)

# Greys: one meaning each, across all panels
GREY_REFSEQ <- "grey88"   # in RefSeq, not in the library (panel 1 only)
GREY_LIB    <- "grey45"   # in the library; the denominator of every panel

OUT_DIR   <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/plots/20261103_v9_greyfix_noFiers"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
OUT_PDF_A <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_v9_anyhit.pdf")
OUT_PDF_B <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_v9_cmclass.pdf")
OUT_SVG_A <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_v9_anyhit.svg")
OUT_SVG_B <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_v9_cmclass.svg")
OUT_CSV   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "virome_summary.csv")
OUT_DET   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "detection_summary.csv")
OUT_QC    <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_qc_checks.txt")

MIN_REPS    <- 2
MIN_LEN     <- 100
BAR_WIDTH   <- 0.72
POINT_ALPHA <- 0.35
FIGURE_W    <- 10.0
FIGURE_H    <- 7.6

M_LEFT  <- margin(1, 0.5, 1, 2)
M_MID   <- margin(1, 0.5, 1, 0.5)
M_RIGHT <- margin(1, 2, 1, 0.5)

# Legend inset positions (npc). Adjust after the first knit if a legend covers bars.
LEG_P1 <- list(x = 0.84, y = 0.99, jx = 1, jy = 1)
# CM legend at bottom-right: at top-right (y=0.99) its semi-transparent box overlapped a family
# row (Botourmiaviridae) and read as a phantom light-grey bar. Bottom-right sits over empty space.
LEG_CM <- list(x = 0.99, y = 0.02, jx = 1, jy = 0)

# Figure 1 shows ONLY models known before this study (decided 2026-11-03):
# xrRNA classes 1a, 1b, 2, 3, 4 and the dumbbell element (Rfam RF00525, published, hence known
# going in). Models developed during the study are annotated in the peaks table but NOT drawn,
# and do not count toward "with a CM match":
#   class1c.cm_hit          pestivirus class 1c, defined in this study
#   future in-study models  e.g. an expanded class 1b, orthoflavivirus subclasses
# When an expanded class 1b model exists, Fig. 1 keeps the ORIGINAL CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.
# Dumbbell is a distinct 3'UTR element, not an xrRNA class, so it is labelled "Dumbbell" rather
# than a numbered class and sits last in the single-class priority.
CM_COLS <- c(
  "Class 1a" = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Class 1b" = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Class 2"  = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  "Class 3"  = "cl3_NAR_2025.align.mpkadded.edited.confident.dedup.IDcurated.SS_cons.cm_hit",
  "Class 4"  = "cl4.cm_hit",   # replaced by the v9 column when present; see CLASS4_PREFERRED
  "Dumbbell" = "dumbbell_RF00525.cm_hit"
)
# Class 4 model: decision 9 selected v9. The class was known before the study (Dilweg et al. 2023),
# but the v9 model was refit in this study (nine rounds). Set to "cl4.cm_hit" to use the
# pre-study model instead.
CLASS4_PREFERRED <- "class4_cl4_v9_20260824.cm_hit"
```

## 1. Parse FASTA

```{r parse_fasta}
lines   <- readLines(FASTA_FILE)
headers <- sub("^>", "", lines[startsWith(lines, ">")])
rx      <- "^([^|]+)\\|(\\d+)-(\\d+)_(.+)$"
matched <- regmatches(headers, regexec(rx, headers))

parse_one <- function(m) {
  if (length(m) < 5) return(NULL)
  data.frame(acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", m[2]),
             length    = as.integer(m[4]) - as.integer(m[3]),
             feature   = m[5], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
fasta_df <- bind_rows(lapply(matched, parse_one)) %>%
  filter(!acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)

utr_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("3UTR", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

ig_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("intergenic", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

message(glue("{nrow(fasta_df)} features parsed | {nrow(utr_df)} 3'UTR | {nrow(ig_df)} intergenic >= {MIN_LEN} nt"))
```

## 2. Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy}
tax_all <- read_csv(CSV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    phylum    = if_else(is.na(phylum) | phylum == "", "Unannotated", phylum),
    family    = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "" | family == "Unannotated",
                        "Unannotated", family)
  )

excluded <- tax_all %>%
  filter(family %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES | acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)
message(glue("EXCLUDED {nrow(excluded)} accession(s): ",
             "{paste(excluded$accession, ' (', excluded$family, ')', sep = '', collapse = ', ')}"))
if (nrow(excluded) != length(EXCLUDE_ACCESSIONS))
  warning(glue("expected {length(EXCLUDE_ACCESSIONS)} excluded accessions, found {nrow(excluded)}"))

tax_df <- tax_all %>%
  filter(!family %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES, !acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)

message(glue("taxonomy: {nrow(tax_df)} accessions | {n_distinct(tax_df$family)} families | ",
             "{n_distinct(tax_df$phylum)} phyla"))
```

---

## 3. NCBI RefSeq totals

```{r ncbi}
# Per-family count of RefSeq COMPLETE NUCLEOTIDE RECORDS, Entrez nuccore 2026-10-19:
#   "FAMILY"[Organism] AND refseq[filter] AND complete[completeness]
# complete[completeness] = the record's completeness flag is "complete" (not partial); it is a nuccore
# record-level property, NOT the assembly-level "Complete Genome" status. Counts records, so a segmented
# genome contributes one per segment and isolates each count -- not a species/genome count, and not the
# same quantity as the NCBI-virus-space supplement. No host or molecule-type filter. Full definition and
# caveats: FIGURES.md section 9.4.
ncbi_counts <- read_csv(NCBI_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(n_ncbi = ncbi_total) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_ncbi), n_ncbi > 0, !family %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES)
```

---

## 4. Input — RppH-only (R replicates)

```{r input}
# R1..X3 are booleans from accession_presence_by_sample.py: an accession is "present" in a sample
# if ANY of its reference segments has >=1 mapped read (int(mapped) > 0) in that sample's k1.mq0 BAM
# (one reported alignment, MAPQ >= 0, so multimappers count). in_r_input is therefore ">=1 read in
# >=1 RppH replicate" -- a pool-presence call, not a depth/detectability call. This is the current
# Fig. 1 denominator; decision 32 would replace it with a detectability floor.
# PROVENANCE (confirmed 2026-11-03): the _261019 table is the orderedRef one (built 2026-10-19 in the
# orderedRef postproc dir; accession set matches the ordered library), NOT the vintage fs4 alignment.
# It still uses the >0-read threshold (decision 32). See FIGURES.md section 11.6.
presence <- read_csv(PRESENCE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean  = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    in_r_input = R1 | R2 | R3,
    in_x_exp   = X1 | X2 | X3
  ) %>%
  filter(!acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)

input_accs <- presence %>% filter(in_r_input) %>% pull(acc_clean)

input_counts <- tibble(acc_clean = input_accs) %>%
  inner_join(tax_df, by = "acc_clean") %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_input = n_distinct(acc_clean),
    phylum  = names(sort(table(phylum), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

presence_summary <- presence %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    in_r_input & in_x_exp  ~ "R and X (both)",
    in_r_input & !in_x_exp ~ "R only (input, not in Xrn1)",
    !in_r_input & in_x_exp ~ "X only (Xrn1, not in input)",
    TRUE                   ~ "Neither"
  )) %>% count(category)
print(presence_summary)
print(presence %>% summarise(across(c(R1, R2, R3, X1, X2, X3), sum)))
message(glue("{length(input_accs)} input accessions | {sum(input_counts$n_input)} joined to taxonomy"))
```

## 5. Output — XR-positive accessions with CM annotation

```{r load_peaks}
peaks_raw <- read_csv(PEAKS_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean      = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", sub("\\|.*", "", accession)),
    family         = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "Unannotated",
                             "Unannotated", family),
    n_reps_passing = as.integer(n_reps_passing),
    peak_pass_R1   = as.logical(peak_pass_R1),
    peak_pass_R2   = as.logical(peak_pass_R2),
    peak_pass_R3   = as.logical(peak_pass_R3),
    treated_sf_R1  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R1),
    treated_sf_R2  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R2),
    treated_sf_R3  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R3),
    qvalue_R1      = as.numeric(qvalue_R1),
    qvalue_R2      = as.numeric(qvalue_R2),
    qvalue_R3      = as.numeric(qvalue_R3),
    any_hit        = as.logical(any_hit)
  ) %>%
  filter(!family %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES, !acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)

message(glue("candidate rows: {nrow(peaks_raw)}"))
print(table(peaks_raw$n_reps_passing, useNA = "ifany"))

# CM columns: report what the file carries, so the CM set used is visible in the knit.
# Class 4 is read from CLASS4_PREFERRED when the file has it, else from cl4.cm_hit.
cm_hit_cols <- grep("\\.cm_hit$", names(peaks_raw), value = TRUE)
message(glue("CM columns in peaks file ({length(cm_hit_cols)}): {paste(cm_hit_cols, collapse = ', ')}"))
if (CLASS4_PREFERRED %in% cm_hit_cols) CM_COLS["Class 4"] <- CLASS4_PREFERRED
missing_cm <- CM_COLS[!CM_COLS %in% cm_hit_cols]
if (length(missing_cm))
  stop(glue("CM column(s) not in the peaks file: {paste(missing_cm, collapse = ', ')}"))
not_shown_cm <- setdiff(cm_hit_cols, CM_COLS)
if (length(not_shown_cm))
  message(glue("Annotated but not shown in Fig. 1 (in-study or non-class models): ",
               "{paste(not_shown_cm, collapse = ', ')}"))
message(glue("Class 4 read from: {CM_COLS[['Class 4']]}"))

# any_hit in the file is TRUE for a hit by ANY annotated model, including in-study classes.
# Recompute it over the Fig. 1 classes only; keep the file's value as any_hit_all_models.
has_hit <- function(x) !is.na(x) & as.character(x) != ""
peaks_raw$any_hit_all_models <- peaks_raw$any_hit
peaks_raw$any_hit <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(unname(CM_COLS), function(col) has_hit(peaks_raw[[col]])))
message(glue("rows with a hit: all models {sum(peaks_raw$any_hit_all_models, na.rm = TRUE)} | ",
             "Fig. 1 classes {sum(peaks_raw$any_hit)}"))
```

```{r filter_classify}
passing_tiles <- peaks_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_reps_passing), n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS) %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = case_when(
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Class 1a"]]]]) ~ "Class 1a",
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Class 1b"]]]]) ~ "Class 1b",
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Class 2"]]]])  ~ "Class 2",
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Class 3"]]]])  ~ "Class 3",
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Class 4"]]]])  ~ "Class 4",
      has_hit(.data[[CM_COLS[["Dumbbell"]]]]) ~ "Dumbbell",
      TRUE                                 ~ "No CM hit"
    ),
    cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = c("Class 1a","Class 1b","Class 2",
                                           "Class 3","Class 4","Dumbbell","No CM hit"))
  )

det_accs <- passing_tiles %>%
  group_by(family, acc_clean) %>%
  slice_max(n_reps_passing, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

message(glue("{nrow(det_accs)} XR-positive accessions | {n_distinct(det_accs$family)} families"))
print(table(det_accs$cm_class))
```

### Sanity check — thresholds

```{r sanity_filter}
all_tsf <- c(det_accs$treated_sf_R1[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R1)],
             det_accs$treated_sf_R2[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R2)],
             det_accs$treated_sf_R3[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R3)]) %>% na.omit()
all_qval <- c(det_accs$qvalue_R1[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R1)],
              det_accs$qvalue_R2[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R2)],
              det_accs$qvalue_R3[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R3)]) %>% na.omit()
message(glue("treated_sf: {round(min(all_tsf),4)} – {round(max(all_tsf),4)}"))
message(glue("qvalue:     {signif(min(all_qval),3)} – {signif(max(all_qval),3)}"))
stopifnot("treated_sf below 0.3" = min(all_tsf) >= 0.3,
          "qvalue above 0.01"    = max(all_qval) <= 0.01)
message("Filter verified")
```

## 6. Summaries

```{r summaries}
output_counts <- det_accs %>% group_by(family) %>% summarise(n_output = n(), .groups = "drop")

family_sum <- input_counts %>%
  left_join(ncbi_counts, by = "family") %>%
  left_join(output_counts, by = "family") %>%
  replace_na(list(n_output = 0)) %>%
  mutate(n_ncbi_capped = pmax(n_ncbi, n_input, na.rm = TRUE))

# Exclusion guard: halts the knit if an excluded family or accession reached a plotted table
stopifnot(
  "excluded family in family_sum" = !any(family_sum$family %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES),
  "excluded family in det_accs"   = !any(det_accs$family   %in% EXCLUDE_FAMILIES),
  "excluded accession in input"   = !any(input_accs        %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN),
  "excluded accession in det_accs"= !any(det_accs$acc_clean %in% EXCLUDE_ACC_CLEAN)
)

write_csv(family_sum, OUT_CSV)

# species  = NCBI species-rank node (current ICTV binomial)
# organism = GenBank ORGANISM line (familiar name); use this for anything a reader sees
det_named <- det_accs %>%
  left_join(tax_df %>% select(acc_clean, accession, organism, species, genus, phylum),
            by = "acc_clean", suffix = c("", "_tax")) %>%
  select(family, genus, acc_clean, accession, organism, species,
         n_reps_passing, cm_class, any_hit) %>%
  arrange(family, organism)

write_csv(det_named, OUT_DET)
message(glue("detection summary: {nrow(det_named)} rows | ",
             "missing organism: {sum(is.na(det_named$organism))} | ",
             "missing species: {sum(is.na(det_named$species))}"))

n_phyla <- n_distinct(family_sum$phylum[family_sum$phylum != "Unannotated"])
message(glue("{sum(family_sum$n_input)} input | {sum(family_sum$n_output)} XR-positive | ",
             "{nrow(family_sum)} families | {n_phyla} phyla"))
```

## 7. Colours and factor order

```{r colours_order}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Pisuviricota"    = "#4472C4",
  "Kitrinoviricota" = "#C9542A",
  "Lenarviricota"   = "#70AD47",
  "Duplornaviricota"= "#8E7CC3",
  "Negarnaviricota" = "#A6A6A6",
  "Unannotated"     = "#999999"
)
cm_colors <- c(
  "Class 1a" = "#B5179E",
  "Class 1b" = "#7209B7",
  "Class 2"  = "#3A0CA3",
  "Class 3"  = "#1B998B",
  "Class 4"  = "#136F63",
  "Dumbbell" = "#8C564B"
)
anyhit_colors <- c("CM hit" = "#F3722C")
NO_CM_LABEL   <- "No CM hit"
region_colors <- c("3′ UTR" = "#E07B54", "Intergenic" = "#6BAED6")

lib_fill_colors <- c("RefSeq, not in library" = GREY_REFSEQ,
                     "Ordered library"        = GREY_LIB)

phylum_rank <- c("Pisuviricota"=1, "Kitrinoviricota"=2, "Lenarviricota"=3,
                 "Duplornaviricota"=4, "Negarnaviricota"=5, "Unannotated"=99)

fam_plot <- family_sum %>%
  mutate(phylum_idx = coalesce(phylum_rank[phylum], 50L)) %>%
  arrange(phylum_idx, n_input) %>%
  mutate(family = fct_inorder(factor(family)))

fam_levels <- levels(fam_plot$family)
n_fam      <- length(fam_levels)
message(glue("{n_fam} families on the y axis"))

add_phylum <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels)) %>%
    left_join(fam_plot %>% select(family, phylum), by = "family") %>%
    filter(!is.na(family))
}

utr_joined <- utr_df %>% inner_join(tax_df %>% select(acc_clean, family), by = "acc_clean") %>% filter(!is.na(family))
ig_joined  <- ig_df  %>% inner_join(tax_df %>% select(acc_clean, family), by = "acc_clean") %>% filter(!is.na(family))
obs_both <- bind_rows(
  add_phylum(utr_joined) %>% mutate(region = "3′ UTR"),
  add_phylum(ig_joined)  %>% mutate(region = "Intergenic")
) %>% mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("3′ UTR","Intergenic")))

det_plot <- det_accs %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels)) %>%
  left_join(fam_plot %>% select(family, phylum), by = "family") %>%
  filter(!is.na(family))

det_total <- det_plot %>%
  group_by(family, phylum) %>% summarise(n_det = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels))

cm_any <- det_plot %>% filter(any_hit) %>%
  group_by(family) %>% summarise(n_cm = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels), cm_fill = "CM hit")

cm_class <- det_plot %>% filter(cm_class != "No CM hit") %>%
  group_by(family, cm_class) %>% summarise(n_cm = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels)) %>%
  rename(cm_fill = cm_class)
```

## 8. Shared theme

```{r theme}
theme_fig <- function(show_y = FALSE, mar = M_MID) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7.5) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = if (show_y)
                           element_text(size = 6.5, face = "italic",
                                        colour = "grey20", hjust = 1)
                         else element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 5.8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x.top    = element_text(size = 5.8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.title.x.bottom= element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey30",
                                      margin = margin(t = 1)),
    axis.title.x.top   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 6.8, face = "bold", colour = "grey25",
                                      margin = margin(b = 1)),
    plot.margin        = mar
  )
}
legend_inset <- function(pos) {
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(pos$x, pos$y),
    legend.justification = c(pos$jx, pos$jy),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title         = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.42, "lines"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), colour = NA),
    legend.margin        = margin(1, 3, 1, 3)
  )
}
```

```{r panel1}
max_n <- max(fam_plot$n_ncbi_capped, na.rm = TRUE)

phylum_brackets <- fam_plot %>%
  mutate(yi = as.integer(family)) %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(y_lo = min(yi) - 0.45, y_hi = max(yi) + 0.45,
            y_mid = mean(range(yi)), .groups = "drop")

p_count <- ggplot(fam_plot, aes(y = family)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_ncbi_capped, fill = "RefSeq, not in library"), width = BAR_WIDTH) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = lib_fill_colors, breaks = names(lib_fill_colors), name = NULL) +
  geom_segment(data = phylum_brackets,
               aes(x = max_n * 1.05, xend = max_n * 1.05,
                   y = y_lo, yend = y_hi, colour = phylum),
               linewidth = 1.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = phylum_brackets,
            aes(x = max_n * 1.17, y = y_mid, label = phylum, colour = phylum),
            angle = 90, size = 1.75, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_n * 1.24), breaks = pretty_breaks(3),

  labs(title = "Library vs NCBI", x = "RefSeq genomes", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = TRUE, mar = M_LEFT) +
```

## 11. Panel 3 — XR-positive accessions

```{r panel3}
# XR-positive accessions per family, in GREY_LIB. No input backdrop and no phylum colour: the
# input denominator is dropped so the axis scales to the XR counts (not the much larger input
# counts), and phylum is already shown by the brackets in panel 1. This grey bar is the same
# bar that the CM panel uses as its denominator, with CM class overlaid there.
mx_xr <- max(det_total$n_det, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.04

p_det <- ggplot(det_total, aes(y = family, x = n_det)) +
  geom_col(fill = GREY_LIB, width = BAR_WIDTH) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, mx_xr), breaks = pretty_breaks(3),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
                     sec.axis = dup_axis(name = NULL)) +
  labs(title = "XR-positive", x = "accessions", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = FALSE)
```

## 12. Panel 4 — CM matches

```{r panel4_fn}
# Backdrop = all XR-positive accessions in the family, in GREY_LIB. The CM bar is drawn
# over it from 0, so the visible grey remainder is exactly the XR-positive accessions with
# no CM hit. The backdrop carries a legend key so that remainder is labelled.
build_p_cm <- function(cm_data, fill_vals, fill_name) {
  mx <- max(det_total$n_det, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.04
  vals <- c(fill_vals, setNames(GREY_LIB, NO_CM_LABEL))
  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = det_total, aes(y = family, x = n_det, fill = NO_CM_LABEL),
             width = BAR_WIDTH) +
    geom_col(data = cm_data, aes(y = family, x = n_cm, fill = cm_fill),
             width = BAR_WIDTH, position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = vals, breaks = names(vals), name = fill_name,
                      drop = FALSE,
                      guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top", ncol = 1)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, mx), breaks = pretty_breaks(3),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
                       sec.axis = dup_axis(name = NULL)) +
    labs(title = "CM matches", x = "accessions", y = NULL) +
    theme_fig(show_y = FALSE) +
    legend_inset(LEG_CM)
}

p_cm_a <- build_p_cm(cm_any,   anyhit_colors, "CM match")
p_cm_b <- build_p_cm(cm_class, cm_colors,     "CM class")
```

## 13. Assemble and save

```{r assemble, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
save_fig <- function(p_cm, out_pdf, out_svg, cm_caption) {
  plots <- cowplot::align_plots(p_count, p_det, p_cm, p_lengths,
                                align = "v", axis = "lr")
  fig <- cowplot::plot_grid(plots[[1]], plots[[2]], plots[[3]], plots[[4]],
                            nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 0.58, 0.58, 0.88))
  final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
      "+ssRNA virome library — composition, XR sites, CM matches and feature lengths",
      fontface = "bold", size = 9, x = 0.005, hjust = 0, colour = "grey10"),
    cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
      glue("{sum(family_sum$n_input)} accessions in the ordered library  ·  ",
           "{nrow(det_accs)} XR-positive (≥{MIN_REPS} of 3 replicates)  ·  ",
           "{sum(det_accs$any_hit, na.rm=TRUE)} with a CM match  ·  ",
           "{nrow(family_sum)} families  ·  {n_phyla} phyla"),
      size = 7, x = 0.005, hjust = 0, colour = "grey45"),
    fig,
    cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
      glue("Light grey = RefSeq complete genomes not in the library (NCBI nuccore, 2026-10-19); dark grey = in the library (each panel's denominator). ",
           "Panel 2: dark grey = accessions with ≥1 XR site (treated_sf ≥ 0.3, ctrl_sf ≤ 0.1, fold ≥ 3, stall_reads ≥ 10, q ≤ 0.01, in ≥{MIN_REPS} of 3 reps). ",
           "Panel 3: dark grey = XR-positive, no hit to a previously described model (xrRNA classes 1a, 1b, 2, 3, 4 or dumbbell, Rfam RF00525); colour = {cm_caption}; models defined in this study not shown. ",
           "Panel 4: 3′UTR and intergenic feature lengths, < {MIN_LEN} nt excluded. ",
           "Fiersviridae (2 bacteriophage accessions, host mis-annotated) excluded."),
      size = 5.8, x = 0.005, hjust = 0, colour = "grey55"),
    ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.026, 0.021, 1, 0.046)
  )
  ggsave(out_pdf, final, width = FIGURE_W, height = FIGURE_H, device = cairo_pdf)
  message("PDF -> ", out_pdf)
  svglite::svglite(out_svg, width = FIGURE_W, height = FIGURE_H, fix_text_size = FALSE)
  print(final); dev.off()
  message("SVG -> ", out_svg)
  invisible(final)
}

fig_a <- save_fig(p_cm_a, OUT_PDF_A, OUT_SVG_A, "accessions with any CM match")
fig_b <- save_fig(p_cm_b, OUT_PDF_B, OUT_SVG_B, "CM class (1a > 1b > 2 > 3 > 4 > dumbbell by priority)")
```
